# University of Bridgeport

> A leading Connecticut university offering flexible undergraduate, graduate, and professional degree programs with strong career development and financial aid support.

University of Bridgeport serves prospective and current students with comprehensive admissions pathways, robust financial aid options, and career-focused academic programs across multiple colleges including Engineering, Health Sciences, and Business. The university emphasizes accessibility through test-optional policies, transfer credit guarantees, and diverse scholarship opportunities.

## Key Topics

- Admissions
- Financial Aid
- Scholarships
- Undergraduate Programs
- Graduate Programs

## Admissions & Application

- [Apply for Admission](https://www.bridgeport.edu/apply): Application portal for undergraduate, graduate, and physician assistant programs.
- [Admissions](https://www.bridgeport.edu/admissions): Main admissions hub for undergraduate, graduate, and professional programs.
- [Undergraduate Admissions](https://www.bridgeport.edu/admissions/undergraduate): Undergraduate admissions with test-optional policy and scholarship information.
- [Graduate Student Resources](https://www.bridgeport.edu/admissions/graduate): Graduate admissions and resources for master's and doctoral degree programs.
- [Online Admissions](https://www.bridgeport.edu/admissions/online): Online program admissions with application requirements and financial aid info.
- [Transfer Admissions](https://www.bridgeport.edu/admissions/transfer): Transfer admissions guide with CT Guarantee program and credit policies.
- [International Admissions](https://www.bridgeport.edu/admissions/international): International student admissions with application requirements and viewbook.

## Financial Aid & Scholarships

- [Cost and Financial Aid](https://www.bridgeport.edu/cost-financial-aid): Financial aid overview with tuition costs and personalized financial planning.
- [Scholarships and Financial Aid](https://www.bridgeport.edu/cost-financial-aid/financial-aid/types-of-aid): Scholarship types including merit-based, STEM, and music scholarships.
- [Tuition and Fees](https://www.bridgeport.edu/cost-financial-aid/tuition-fees): Detailed tuition, fees, and cost of attendance information by program.

## Academic Programs

- [Academic Programs](https://www.bridgeport.edu/academics/programs): Directory of undergraduate, graduate, doctoral programs and certificates.

## Prospective Student Engagement

- [Request Information](https://www.bridgeport.edu/landingpages/learn-more-web): Information request form for prospective students on programs and scholarships.
- [Visit UB](https://www.bridgeport.edu/visit): Campus visit scheduling with virtual tours and open house information.
- [University of Bridgeport Homepage](https://www.bridgeport.edu): University of Bridgeport homepage showcasing programs and flexible degree options.

## Student & Family Support

- [Parents](https://www.bridgeport.edu/parents): Parent resources covering academics, financial aid, and family engagement.
- [Resources for Employers](https://www.bridgeport.edu/heckman/career-development/employers-alumni): Center for Career Development services for employer recruitment and alumni engagement.

## Giving & Support

- [Support UB](https://www.bridgeport.edu/support-ub): Fundraising and philanthropy hub for donations and alumni giving programs.

## Optional

- [COVID-19](https://www.bridgeport.edu/covid-19): COVID-19 hub with testing, contact tracing, and campus safety guidelines.
- [Request Information (Career Programs)](https://www.bridgeport.edu/learnmore): Information request form for career-oriented programs and scholarships.
